# Shared lazy-load adapter fixtures

`compound.rdx` and `zlib.rdb` are copied from the corresponding checked-in
fixtures in `crates/rd-rds/tests/fixtures/data/lazyload/`. They are kept here
so `rd-helpdb` tests and packaged source archives do not depend on a sibling
crate checkout. The source fixture is generated by
`crates/rd-rds/tests/fixtures/generate_lazyload_fixture.R`; regenerate the
source fixture there first, then copy these two files when their bytes change.
